metadata.description: Higgsfield AI video & image generation skills for Claude Code — 15 Seedance prompt-engineering styles plus an automation pack that drives the official Higgsfield API.

plugins.name: higgsfield-prompts
plugins.description: 15 Seedance 2.0 prompt-engineering skills (cinematic, 3D/CGI, anime, e-commerce ad, real estate, and more). Each turns Claude into a specialist prompt engineer that produces production-grade, paste-ready video prompts. No API key required.

plugins.name: higgsfield-automation
plugins.description: Generate images and videos on Higgsfield end-to-end via the official Higgsfield API (higgsfield-mcp). Includes image generation, Seedance video generation, and a full UGC ad pipeline. Requires HF_API_KEY and HF_SECRET and consumes Higgsfield credits.
